snippet.title: Y'Ryando - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
"Y'Ryando" is a Lovecraftian text adventure game, where players will participate in the bizarre events encountered by several story characters in a coastal town from a unique perspective.
Through random events and active choices, players can influence the fate of the characters and subsequently determine the outcome of the story.

Hi! I am IndieCain, an independent game developer, currently working with 3 partners on this game. We hope to bring new stories and experiences to all fans of Lovecraft and Cthulhu.
